## Peer-reviewed publications

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| warning: false

my_name <- "Castro Sánchez-Bermejo P"   # your name is shown in bold in author lists

pubs  <- yaml::read_yaml("publications.yml")
dates <- vapply(pubs, function(p) as.character(p$date), character(1))
years <- substr(dates, 1, 4)

for (y in sort(unique(years), decreasing = TRUE)) {
  cat("\n### ", y, "\n\n", sep = "")
  idx <- which(years == y)
  idx <- idx[order(dates[idx], decreasing = TRUE)]
  for (i in idx) {
    p <- pubs[[i]]
    authors <- gsub(my_name, paste0("**", my_name, "**"), p$author, fixed = TRUE)
    cat("::: {.pub-entry}\n",
        "**[", p$title, "](", p$path, ")**  \n",
        authors, "  \n",
        "*", p$description, "*\n",
        ":::\n\n", sep = "")
  }
}
```
